description: This file defines translations for multiple languages and configures a tab and widget related to 'behaviors' within an allure reporting plugin. It primarily adds multilingual support for UI elements and integrates a new tab and widget into the allure API.

classes.name: allure.components.WidgetStatusView
classes.description: A widget component for displaying status view related to behaviors, extended with specific configurations such as rowTag, title, baseUrl, and showLinks.

methods.name: onEnter
methods.description: A callback function invoked when entering the behaviors tab, creating a new TreeLayout component with specific parameters.
